description: Main entry point and root widget setup for a Flutter attendance tracking app. Implements app initialization, theme setup, authentication gating, and bottom navigation with multiple screens.

classes.name: AttendanceApp
classes.description: Root widget of the app applying themes and setting up providers.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree with MultiProvider and MaterialApp.

classes.name: _AuthGate
classes.description: Decides which screen to show based on authentication state. Shows a loading indicator, login screen, or root shell.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds UI based on AuthProvider's state.

classes.name: RootShell
classes.description: Main authenticated app shell with bottom navigation to different sections like dashboard, attendance, and reports.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the scaffold with app bar and bottom navigation, displays corresponding page.

classes.name: _DashboardCard
classes.description: Welcomes the user with a themed card showing user info and an icon.

methods.name: build
